identity.one_liner: 给 AI agent 的 Git 工作流最佳实践技能包
identity.review: 遵循 Anthropic 发起的 Agent Skills 开放标准的技能包，向 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等兼容 agent 提供程序性知识：分支策略（Git Flow/GitHub Flow/trunk-based）、Conventional Commits 规范、PR 协作流程、CI/CD 集成、Git hooks 与高级操作。附带 /pr-finish 命令驱动 PR 到合并完成，并自带 hooks 与 commands 文件；npx skills 安装路径不覆盖 hooks/commands。提供 marketplace、git clone、npx、release、Composer、npm 六种安装方式，由 Netresearch DTT GmbH 维护，采用 split licensing 并声明组织级治理与安全检查流程。
highlights: 覆盖分支策略、Conventional Commits、PR 流程、CI/CD 集成与 Git hooks 的知识包
附带 /pr-finish 命令自动驱动 PR 到合并完成
兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等支持 Agent Skills 规范的平台
use_cases: 让 AI agent 按最佳实践搭建 Git Flow 或 trunk-based 分支策略
让 agent 实施 Conventional Commits 与语义化版本
让 agent 自动处理 PR：rebase、修复 CI、回复评审直至合并

evidence: L7: This is an **Agent Skill** following the open standard originally developed by Anthropic and released for cross-platform
L15: > Skills are portable packages of procedural knowledge that work across any AI agent supporting the Agent Skills specifi
L3: Expert patterns for Git version control workflows including branching strategies, commit conventions, collaborative work
